feedbackMessages.thankYouFooter: Thank you for contributing to our sustainability journey at Republic Polytechnic!
feedbackMessages.consentPrompt: Your feedback helps us create a more sustainable future. Your responses will be kept confidential.
feedbackMessages.detailsPrompt: Please provide your details so we can track your contributions.
feedbackMessages.feedbackPrompt: Share your thoughts on our sustainability initiatives.
feedbackMessages.pledgePrompt: Would you like to make a pledge to support sustainability?

pledgePresets.title: Walk, cycle or take public transport
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to walk, cycle or take public transport for short trips at least 3 times a week this month.

pledgePresets.title: Switch off lights and fans
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to switch off lights and fans whenever I leave a room, every day this month.

pledgePresets.title: Bring my own bottle and bag
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to bring my own bottle and bag instead of using single-use plastic, every day this month.

pledgePresets.title: Keep our waters clean
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to bin my litter and pick up at least 5 pieces of rubbish near drains or waterways every week this month.

pledgePresets.title: Waste less food
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to take only what I can finish at every meal this month.

pledgePresets.title: Volunteer in the community
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to join one volunteer or community service activity within the next 3 months.

pledgePresets.title: Inspire friends and family
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to share one sustainability tip with 3 friends or family members this week.

pledgePresets.title: Include others in group activities
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to invite someone who might feel left out to join a school or community activity this month.

pledgePresets.title: Donate items in good condition
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to donate one item I no longer use to a local charity or community drive this month.

pledgePresets.title: Help a classmate learn
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to spend 30 minutes helping a classmate with a topic they find difficult this month.

pledgePresets.title: Act with honesty and integrity
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to make fair and honest choices, and to speak up when I see something unethical, starting today.

pledgePresets.title: Follow and promote school guidelines
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to follow my school's sustainability and conduct guidelines, and remind my group to do the same, this semester.

pledgePresets.title: Credit sources in my work
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to credit the sources, images and ideas I use in every school assignment this semester.

pledgePresets.title: Keep group spending transparent
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to record shared project expenses and show the receipts to my team this semester.

pledgePresets.title: Record group decisions fairly
pledgePresets.text: I pledge to write down key project decisions and share them with everyone in my group this semester.
